blurb: Built into the side of Moravia Point in the 1930s, the Ephraim Fire Station was the first firehouse in Door County and was used until 1990 by the Fire Department. In 1990, a new fire station was built on Norway Street and the Fire House was restored and became a Museum in 2009.The Fire House Museum serves as a tribute to Assistant Fire Chief Bill Weborg, the first Door County Firefighter to die in the line of duty.
